scientific_model: DNA_COARSE_GRAINED (oxDNA2; Nanobase input files declare interaction_type=DNA2, salt_concentration=2.0, sim_type=MD, ensemble=nvt, thermostat=john, dt=0.003; equilibrium 1e9 steps, pull 1e7, release 2e7; temperatures 23C/37C across the source campaign - provided Nanobase inputs are 37C)
simulation_engine: oxDNA (Zenodo README: 'the oxDNA2 model using the late-2020 version of the oxDNA simulation package'; exact engine commit/tag UNKNOWN - no pin recorded in any audited surface)
topology_format: oxDNA_top; cadnano JSON design also provided (NE_halo_dsDNA.json, internal name hinge-ok-halo-tag-dsDNA.json) importable via TacoxDNA
configuration_format: oxDNA_dat (equilibrium endpoint configurations, e.g. NE.dat header t=1000000000, box 310x310x310)

observables.name: inter_arm_angle
observables.definition: angle between principal axes (SVD) of the two origami arms, computed from aligned oxDNA trajectories; source script pins reference nucleotide indices arm1 [2034, 6657], arm2 [4593, 4411]

observables.name: arm_center_distance_nm
observables.definition: distance between arm centers in oxDNA units multiplied by 0.85 nm/unit conversion

observables.name: equipartition_spring_constant
observables.definition: effective angular spring constant K = 0.5/variance from equilibrium angle fluctuations

observables.name: closing_rate_under_16pN
observables.definition: structure closing rate under 16 pN external pulling applied between the polymerase attachment point and the dsDNA template terminator (T7_force.txt constant_trap: particle 8694, ref 7374, stiff 0.3290, r0 8.8)
observables.definition_source: paper Methods + Nanobase input_pull / T7_force.txt (pinned digests in this pack)

observables.name: flexure_hbond_occupancy
observables.definition: hydrogen-bond occupancy matrix inside the six ssDNA flexure windows

observables.name: driver_follower_motion_transfer
observables.definition: correlation/transfer of pulsation between driver (nanoengine) and passive follower; candidate NanoLab E5/NL7 observable
observables.definition_source: paper reports D-F pair analysis (driver_*/follower_* data files exist in sulcgroup/hinges); exact processing provenance UNKNOWN - UNVERIFIED for NanoLab until a dedicated analysis protocol is written

observables.name: nucleotide_index_mapping_for_ne_top
observables.definition: verification that get_k.py reference indices map to the arm structures of the pinned NE.top/nNE.top imports
observables.definition_source: index-to-structure mapping not documented in any audited surface

known_limitations: GPU non-determinism: source trajectories are not bit-reproducible from a seed (Zenodo README); NanoLab reproductions can only reproduce statistical trends
Zenodo trajectories are decimated to every 20th configuration (2000 -> 100 confs per trajectory)
Analysis scripts are research-grade: hard-coded personal paths, missing index files (ss_ids.txt), SLURM assumptions - not runnable as-is
Transcription actuation is modeled in MD only as an external 16 pN pulling force; the chemical fuel (NTP/T7RNAP transcription) is NOT part of the coarse-grained simulation
Import validation in EX-PREP-S17-R1 verifies file structure only (PINNED_IMPORT_VERIFIED); no NanoLab simulation, reproduction or mechanism claim is made
Physical fabricability in a wet lab is NOT established by any of this
